senses.gloss:
यर्हि यर्हि (fr. the pronom. base 3. य;
its proper correlative is तर्हि or एतर्हि, but it may
[]
be followed by तदा, तत्र, अथ, &c.), when, at
what time, whenever, while, whereas, since, as,
because; (यर्हि is found in construction with either
pres. or pot.; also with impf. or perf. or aor.)
यार्कायण यार्कायण, अस्, m. a patronymic.
